kevin: Heads-up — after merging r/serve:kernel-routing (PR #2543) perf CI shows ~+18% 95th decode latency on short-chat workloads. failing job: https://ci.internal/reports/1825/slot-12

infra-bot: perf-ci alert — threshold breach (95p latency) on job slot-12. Related artifacts uploaded. :warning:

maria: Looking at perf artifacts now. flamegraph shows more time in attention path and a new memcpy hotspot during decode. suspect kernel routing picked fallback path for small sequence lengths.

raj: Can you bisect to pinpoint commit? I'll start a local perf bisect run on a machine with the short-chat replay set.

maria: quick bisect steps I ran locally:
```
git checkout main
git bisect start --term-old=good --term-new=bad
git bisect good cb3a7f4   # known good before routing changes
git bisect bad 7f4d9b2   # current head with regression
# run perf test (short-chat replay)
# mark good/bad accordingly
```

maria: Found the regression window: it lands on commit 5a1c8e -> "runtime: kernel routing: prefer fused_batched_bias for multihead"

elaine: Interesting — that commit changed selection heuristics and added an extra copy when pads != 0. I think for short sequences we now choose fused_batched_bias which ends up calling attention_fallback on some kernels, causing an extra KV memcpy.

raj: I repro'd with onboard profiler. nvprof snippet (simplified):
```
GPU memcpy HtoD:  12.1ms  (prev 2.3ms)
attention_fwd_kernel:  4.0ms (prev 1.8ms)
fused_batched_bias:  6.5ms (new path)
```

kevin: So fused op + fallback path = extra copies + slower kernels. Any chance kernel-selector picked the wrong kernel because of sequence-length histogram misread? We recently changed the histogram bucket boundaries in metrics/seq-dist.

maria: Bingo — the selector uses seq_hist buckets to pick precompiled kernels. The bucket edge change shifted many short chats into the "longer" bin, which then triggered fused path that doesn't have optimized kv path. If we revert just the bucket-edge tweak, selector picks the precompiled short-seq kernel and perf goes back to baseline.

raj: Putting a rollout hold on the merge and starting a quick revert PR for the histogram boundaries. Also opening an internal issue to add a unit test that validates kernel selection for seq lengths < 32.

deploy-bot: Canary paused for r/serve:kernel-routing because of perf regression tag.

kevin: Action items:
- maria: push revert PR for histogram-edge change (short-term revert) :hourglass:
- raj: add a regression test that runs short-chat profile in CI (blocking merge) :white_check_mark:
- elaine: add a guard in kernel-selector to prefer precompiled short kernels when pads==0 (defensive)

maria: Created PR #2550 (revert histogram edges) and uploaded perf run showing 95p latency back within 2% of baseline. https://ci.internal/pr/2550/artifacts

raj: I'll follow up with a proper fix in kernel-selection logic (feature branch) and a e2e perf test.

kevin: Thanks team. Keep the notes in the issue. If anyone sees other perf anomalies in adjacent runs, ping me. :eyes:
